sentences.en: The optometrist measures the patient's visual acuity.
sentences.zh: 验光师会测量患者的视力。

sentences.en: Mary regularly needs to have ingrowing eyelashes trimmed by an optometrist.
sentences.zh: 玛丽经常需要找验光师修剪倒睫。

sentences.en: Tom isn't an optometrist. He's an obstetrician.
sentences.zh: 汤姆不是验光师，他是一名妇产科医生。

senses.zh: 验光师；视力测定者；配镜师
